moisture_pct.quote: > This food consists of 53.3% water, 23.3% protein,

ammonia.reason: Short 4-week aging with low amino acid deamination and lightly washed rind.

animal_barnyard.reason: Light brine wash limits Brevibacterium linens p-cresol and indole formation.

bitter.reason: Curd washing removes lactose and limits hydrophobic bitter peptides from chymosin.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti, negligible 2-heptanone and 2-nonanone from beta-oxidation.

browning.reason: Trace residual lactose/galactose with whey protein undergoes Maillard on heating.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism to diacetyl and acetoin in young curd.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Limited lipolysis to butanoic and hexanoic acids in 4-week ripening.

creaminess.reason: High moisture with pasteurized cow fat and smooth demineralized protein matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Elastic washed-curd paracasein network at pH 5.23 fractures little.

firmness.reason: Washed pressed curd at ~53% moisture gives supple sliceable semi-soft body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde and 2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism.

fruity.reason: Trace ethyl butanoate from esterase esterification of free fatty acids with ethanol.

goaty.reason: Cow milk lacks caprine C6-C10 branched acids 4-methyloctanoic and 4-ethyloctanoic.

malty_nutty.reason: Low Strecker 3-methylbutanal from leucine catabolism in short-aged curd.

melt.reason: Washed-curd low colloidal calcium phosphate at pH 5.23 allows good flow on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Very low 1-octen-3-ol from linoleate oxidation, no bloomy mold growth.

oil_off.reason: Moderate fat emulsified in intact protein matrix releases little free oil on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step, no guaiacol or syringol from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Curd washing removes lactose, low lactic and acetic acid at pH 5.23.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata, no hot-water alignment of paracasein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Minimal methionine catabolism to methanethiol and dimethyl disulfide.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted but sweet amino acids proline/glycine plus diacetyl perception.

umami.reason: Early rennet and lactococcal proteolysis releases glutamate peptides.
